summary: Penetration tester at Arvato Systems and Lynx Security, junior software engineer at Mitel Networks, and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science student in Brasov. Focused on radio-frequency, embedded and industrial targets, writing own tooling in C and Python, from firmware drivers to protocol clients.

points: Run security assessments of web applications and APIs, from testing and analysis to the written report.
Extend offensive-security methodology and tooling alongside client engagements.
Build internal tools in Python and JavaScript for the OpenScape 4000 Assistant Manager.
Work across Hyper-V virtual machines, Linux and C components of OpenScape 4000 telecom configurations.
Speak on wireless security at local community events.
Also a member of the Invata Cyber Community.
Configured and virtualised OpenScape 4000 telecom systems and worked on C-level components.
First hands-on work with carrier-grade telephony platforms and how they are tested.
Operated CNC machine tools at the Cristian (Brasov) production site.
Worked to engineering drawings and quality requirements within a manufacturing team.
